title: Q2 Pilot: Dedicated Capacity Reservoirs and Adaptive Autoscale — Roadmap & Metrics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Initiative to run a focused Q2 pilot that prototypes 'capacity reservoirs' — small reserved buffer pools paired with adaptive autoscale policies — to reduce tail latency and minimize expensive over-provisioning for Dedicated customers. We will validate SLA preservation under bursty traffic patterns while measuring per-token cost delta and forecast accuracy. The pilot scope covers a single region (us-west-2), two customer cohorts (small-mid enterprise), and three workload classes (chat, streaming generation, embeddings). Outcome: clear go/no-go decision plus playbook and dashboard templates to scale to other regions.

success_metrics: p95 tail latency improvement for chat under 99th percentile bursts <= 15% over baseline
unit cost delta <= 8% compared to steady reserved capacity when normalized for delivered QPS
forecast accuracy (15-min lookahead) >= 85% for autoscale triggers
observability coverage: token-level breakdown + per-route SLOs implemented
risks: Autoscale misfires leading to transient 5xx which could impact SLA and churn
Insufficient telemetry resolution for prefix/KV cache hits — may mask savings
Customer cohort selection bias could overstate efficacy on enterprise patterns
Interference with Dedicated pool scheduling causing noisy neighbor effects
acceptance_criteria: Canary shows p95 latency within target for both chat and streaming workloads
Dashboards show clear cost delta and unit economics calculations for pilot cohorts
Runbook with rollback and escalation paths approved by SRE and Support
Cross-team retrospective scheduled and decision recorded in roadmap doc
tasks: ENG-87421: Implement reservoir allocation controller for dedicated pools
ENG-87422: Add 1s/15s/60s forecast hooks to autoscaler and expose metric
ENG-87423: Instrument token-level cost and latency labeling in request path
DES-3347: Dashboard layout and alert UX for on-call SLOs
PM-87424: Customer cohort selection and invite messaging
notes: Design decision: use conservative reservoir sizing (5-10% of reserved capacity) for pilot to limit risk; rationale documented in design doc.
Trade-off considered: dynamic quantization vs static quantization for cost testing — deferred quantization changes to a follow-up to isolate variables.
We will not test on-prem/private in this pilot due to network variability; create a follow-on hypothesis test in Q3 for Private deployments.
